```{r}

getwd()

people_counter_processed <- read.csv("Data/Processed/PowerBI/EcoCounter_PowerBI_Main2.csv", header = TRUE)


```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# People counter Analysis
# =============================================================================
# Assumes: people_counter_processed is already loaded in your R environment
# Columns: CounterID, DateTime, Date, Hour, Year, Month, Day, Weekday, PedestrianIn, 
#          PedestrianOut, TotalCount, CombinedCount, MonthName, DayOfWeek, WeekNumber,TimeOfDay,
# =============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)   # for STL decomposition + imputation
library(zoo)        # for rolling means / na.approx fallback
library(scales)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}

df <- people_counter_processed
# Ensure Date is Date type
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)

#selecting all relevant columns and renaming TotalCount to PedestrianCount. PedestrainCount takes average of CombinedCount 
df_processed<- df%>%
  select(1,3:12, 14:21)%>%
  rename(PedestrianCount = TotalCount)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Cleaning data looking at how to deal with outliers
# =============================================================================

trail_data <- df_processed %>%
  mutate(
    # Ratio of the larger direction to the total - if one direction dominates, ratio approaches 1
    imbalance_ratio = pmax(PedestriansIn, PedestriansOut) / pmax(CombinedCount, 1),  # avoid div/0
    is_mismatch = imbalance_ratio > 0.95 & CombinedCount > 50,  # tune threshold + minimum volume
    PedestriansIn_clean = if_else(is_mismatch, NA_real_, PedestriansIn),
    PedestriansOut_clean = if_else(is_mismatch, NA_real_, PedestriansOut)
  )

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Monthly visitation graph
# =============================================================================

monthly_summary <- trail_data %>%
  filter(is_mismatch == FALSE, !CounterID == 'Tidepool Lot 2') %>%
  group_by(CounterID, MonthYear) %>%
  summarise(TotalVisitors = sum(CombinedCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(MonthYear_date = ym(MonthYear))  # converts "2025-05" -> Date (2025-05-01)

ggplot(monthly_summary, aes(x = MonthYear_date, y = TotalVisitors, color = CounterID)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of visitors",
    color = "Location",
    title = "Monthly Visitor Counts by Location"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
